title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 500 North Brevard Avenue in Cocoa Beach, Florida, as the "Richard K. Salick Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 500 North Brevard Avenue in Cocoa Beach, Florida, as the "Richard K. Salick Post Office."

summary.headline: Congress named a Cocoa Beach, Florida post office after Richard K. Salick, an honorary designation with no change to postal service.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 500 North Brevard Avenue in Cocoa Beach, Florida, as the "Richard K. Salick Post Office." It is a naming measure only. The summary does not describe any change to mail service, staffing, or fees.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2014, and the summary does not give a separate effective date.
